mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoSelfApproval allows the model to construct an AuditEntry whose entryActor equals the application's appApplicant on a non-initial transition, directly violating the no-self-approval invariant. The injected fact forces exactly such a counterexample to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfApprovalViolation { some ae : AuditEntry | some ae.prevStatus and ae.entryActor = ae.forApp.appApplicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix allows PermMatrix.Allowed to take any value, so a pure-officer user could appear to have unconditional POST permission and an auditor could have PATCH permission, breaking LeastPrivilege. The injection forces an officer→OpPost cell into PermMatrix.Allowed, which is exactly the cell that must be absent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { ROfficer -> OpPost in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OneInFlightPerApplicant allows two LoanApplication atoms to share the same appApplicant while both are in Pending or UnderReview status. The injection creates exactly that scenario.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2 : LoanApplication | a1.appApplicant = a2.appApplicant and a1.appStatus = Pending and a2.appStatus = Pending }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_UniqueInitialAuditEntry allows either zero or two initial (none→pending) audit entries for a single application. The injection forces two distinct AuditEntry atoms to both be initial entries for the same application, violating uniqueness and the append-only deduplication invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateInitialEntry { some disj ae1, ae2 : AuditEntry | ae1.forApp = ae2.forApp and no ae1.prevStatus and no ae2.prevStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ValidAuditTransitions allows an AuditEntry to record a forbidden transition such as Approved→UnderReview or Pending→Rejected. The injection forces a Rejected→Pending audit entry, violating both the valid-transitions invariant and terminal-status immutability.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidTransitionViolation { some ae : AuditEntry | ae.prevStatus = Rejected and ae.newStatus = Pending }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditEndpointAuditorOnly permits a non-auditor (e.g., a pure applicant) to have a successful OpAudit operation, breaking the auditor-only gate on the audit endpoint. The injection forces such a successful non-auditor audit call to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonAuditorAuditAccess { some op : Operation | op.opKind = OpAudit and op.opSucceeded = BTrue and RAuditor not in op.opCaller.userRoles }
